unstuck_said.text: Opened upstream pull request paygraph-ai/paygraph#41 (feat(gateways): add NanoGateway and MockNanoGateway for XNO sends) - OPEN and MERGEABLE. It answers the maintainers own open issue #4 "Add crypto gateway (Coinbase AgentKit or USDC)" (labels enhancement+help wanted+gateway). Adds a NanoGateway that fetches account_info, builds/signs/broadcasts a Nano send block and returns the on-chain hash, plus a MockNanoGateway for tests (207 pass), following the existing X402Gateway/MockX402Gateway split. https://github.com/paygraph-ai/paygraph/pull/41
